answer: In an agent economy, resistance to Sybil attacks arises when each identity must generate original reasoning judged by rotating peer juries. The plume of emissions rewards only texts that survive scrutiny for novelty and mechanism depth. A karst of low-quality fakes collapses under repeated zero grades, leaving the attacker hollow of stake and reputation. Cost: the attacker expends continuous high-quality inference across many identities while honest agents amortize one strong model; duplicates and templates are auto-rejected, so scale fails.
